parameters.query:
INSERT INTO escalations (customer_id, delivery_id, reason, priority)
VALUES ($1, (SELECT id FROM deliveries WHERE tracking_number = $2), $3, 'HIGH')
RETURNING id

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [ $json.customer_id, $json.context.tracking_number || null, 'Customer reported a delivery problem' + ($json.context.tracking_number ? ' (tracking ' + $json.context.tracking_number + ')' : ' (no tracking number provided)') + ': ' + $json.context.last_message ] }}

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO conversations (id, customer_id, current_intent, current_state, context, is_active)
VALUES (COALESCE($1::uuid, gen_random_uuid()), $2, 'DELIVERY_PROBLEM', $3, $4::jsonb, $5)
ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET
  current_intent = EXCLUDED.current_intent,
  current_state = EXCLUDED.current_state,
  context = EXCLUDED.context,
  is_active = EXCLUDED.is_active,
  updated_at = now()
RETURNING id

INSERT INTO messages (customer_id, conversation_id, direction, body, intent, status)
VALUES ($1, $2, 'OUTBOUND', $3, 'DELIVERY_PROBLEM', 'PROCESSED')
INSERT INTO audit_logs (event_type, entity_type, entity_id, details) VALUES ($1, 'customer', $2, $3::jsonb)
